newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF economic indicator stalled in December.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF economic indicator stalled in December.

text.p: Switzerland's Centre for Research of Economic Activity (KOF) said its economic barometer was unchanged in December against November.
KOF is part of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich (ETH).
"In its trend-adjusted form, the KOF/ETH economic barometer remained thus still clearly below the long-term average," KOF said. In November the barometer rose 0.1 percent from October.
"On the basis of the development of the barometer in the second half of the previous year, no improvement in the economy is expected in the first months of this year," KOF said.
In the individual categories, orders on hand for the machinery industry had not improved since the previous month.

The leading construction indicator continued to show a slight decline. Combined labour market indicators signaled a further worsening. Only the monetary leading indicator or "real money aggegate" showed gains, KOF said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
